description: Definitions shared by the card block types.

image.description: A picture stored as a blob in the record owner's repository, with its alt text and proportions.
The picture file. Readers never hand it to a browser without checking its type and re-encoding it; the declared type may be wrong.

alt.description: Alt text for people who cannot see the picture. An empty string means the picture is decorative.

aspectRatio.description: The picture's proportions, so a reader can reserve its space before it loads.

caption.description: Text shown under the picture, where the reader shows one.

aspectRatio.description: Width to height. It may be approximate. Readers clamp extreme proportions. Same shape as app.bsky.embed.defs#aspectRatio.
